_comment: REAL OpenRouter-routed Anthropic response shape captured via live probe (Claude Opus 4.7, 2026-04-27). OpenRouter emits cache READS under prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens (OpenAI-shape canonical name) and cache WRITES under prompt_tokens_details.cache_write_tokens. There is NO `cache_read_tokens` key — that was an aspirational fixture in openrouter_anthropic_usage.json that did not match production. The UsageExtractor must therefore fall back to `cached_tokens` for `cache_read_input_tokens` when no top-level Anthropic field is set.
